# Installing packages
```{r Packages}
library(Seurat)
library(schex)
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(rmarkdown)
library(openxlsx)
```

# Data loading
```{r}
sts.non.malignant <- read_nonmalignant(cfg$final_object)   # Stage 3 non-malignant cells and labels, from the deposited final object
sample.high.myeloid <- as.data.frame(sts.non.malignant@meta.data) %>%
                                  group_by(Sample) %>% 
                                  dplyr::count(Lv.1.Anno) %>% 
                                  dplyr::filter(Lv.1.Anno %in% c("Myeloid", "Mast"), n > 30) %>% 
                                  pull(Sample) %>% 
                                  as.character() %>% unique()# need minimum n=30 cells to do integration

myeloid <- sts.non.malignant %>% subset(subset = Sample %in% sample.high.myeloid &
                                                      Lv.1.Anno %in% c("Myeloid", "Mast"))
```

# MYELOID analysis
## Normalised myeloid a whole to identify DCs
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
# DietSeurat
DefaultAssay(myeloid) <- "RNA"
myeloid <- DietSeurat(myeloid, assays = "RNA", data = TRUE, counts = TRUE)

# to remove additional columns & because we need to split individual samples and redo the SCT, so we need to remove the "^_SCT"
colnames(myeloid[[]]) #check which columns to remove
myeloid[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
myeloid[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
myeloid[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
#myeloid[["SCT_snn_res.0.5"]] <- NULL
#myeloid[["SCT_snn_res.0.6"]] <- NULL
myeloid[["SCT_snn_res.0.7"]] <- NULL
#myeloid[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL

#Removing outliers
myeloid <- subset(myeloid, subset = Sample %in% c("1959","2185"), invert = T)
#myeloid$Sample <- droplevels(myeloid$Sample)

# SCTRANFORM
myeloid.v2 <- SCTransform(myeloid, vst.flavor = "v2", method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = TRUE)

# DIMENTIONALITY REDUCTION
myeloid.v2 <- RunPCA(myeloid.v2, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE, assay = "SCT")
ElbowPlot(myeloid.v2)

DimPlot(myeloid.v2, label = TRUE,
        reduction = "pca", group.by = "Lv.1.Anno") + NoLegend()

myeloid.v2 <- RunUMAP(myeloid.v2, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

# CLUSTERING
myeloid.v2 <- FindNeighbors(myeloid.v2, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

# Determine cluster stability
myeloid.v2 <- FindClusters(myeloid.v2, algorithm = 3,  resolution = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1))
library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(myeloid.v2) # most stable at 0.2 and 0.6

Idents(myeloid.v2) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.8"
DimPlot(myeloid.v2, label = T, label.size = 5) + NoLegend() 

myeloid.v2$seurat_clusters <- NULL
myeloid.v2$seurat_clusters <- myeloid.v2$SCT_snn_res.0.8
myeloid.markers <- FindAllMarkers(myeloid.v2, assay = "SCT", only.pos = T, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
markers <- myeloid.markers %>% filter(cluster %in% c(0, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 13, 14))

top10.markers <-myeloid.markers%>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n=10, order_by = avg_log2FC) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
DotPlot(myeloid.v2, features = c("CLEC10A","CD1C")) + RotatedAxis() + scale_color_gradient2(low="darkblue", mid="white", high="darkred")
```

### Cell_Barcode for small cell class
```{r}
# we knew from our dataset, there are population of langerhan-like DCs
Idents(DC.v2) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.3"
DefaultAssay(DC.v2) <- "RNA"
L.DCs <- subset(DC.v2, CD1A > 1 & CDH20 > 1 )
L.DCs.CB <- L.DCs@meta.data %>% pull(Cell_Ids) # 30 cells

cDC2 <- subset(DC.v2, CD1C > 1 & CLEC10A > 1 )
cDC2.CB <- cDC2@meta.data %>% pull(Cell_Ids) # 11 cells

cycling.myeloid <- subset(myeloid.v2, subset = SCT_snn_res.0.8 == "14") #MKI67+
cycling.CB <- cycling.myeloid@meta.data %>% pull(Cell_Ids) # only 68 cells

aDCs <- subset(myeloid.v2, subset = SCT_snn_res.0.8 == "17") #LAMP3+
aDCs.CB <- aDCs@meta.data %>% pull(Cell_Ids) # only 27 cells

cDC1 <- subset(myeloid.v2, subset = SCT_snn_res.0.8 == "16") #CLEC9A
cDC1.CB <- cDC1@meta.data %>% pull(Cell_Ids) # only 36 cells
```

## Annotation - myeloid subsets - non-integrated
The dendritic cell subsets were picked partly by cluster number in the original analysis (the DC clusters at resolution 0.1, and cycling myeloid cells, migratory DCs and cDC1 at resolution 0.8). Cluster numbers can change between environments, so `Lv.2.Anno` is read from the deposited object (`stage4_myeloid_Lv.2.Anno`), matched by cell ID. The original selection is still applied to the rerun, as `Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster`, and compared with it.

```{r myeloid-annotation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
# Original mapping
metadata <- myeloid.v2@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.2.Anno = case_when(Lv.1.Anno == "Mast" ~ "Mast",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% L.DCs.CB ~ "Langerhans-like DCs",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% cDC1.CB ~ "cDC1",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% cDC2.CB ~ "cDC2",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% aDCs.CB ~ "Migratory DCs",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% cycling.CB ~ "Cycling myeloid",
                                          TRUE ~ "TAMs")) -> metadata
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(myeloid.v2)))
myeloid.v2$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster <- metadata$Lv.2.Anno

# Lv.2.Anno from the deposited object
myeloid.v2$Lv.2.Anno <- deposited_labels(myeloid.v2, "stage4_myeloid_Lv.2.Anno")
myeloid.v2@meta.data %>% group_by(Lv.1.Anno) %>% dplyr::count(Lv.2.Anno)
print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(myeloid.v2$SCT_snn_res.0.8, myeloid.v2$Lv.2.Anno,
                                    "Myeloid: rerun clusters (res 0.8) vs Lv.2.Anno", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(myeloid.v2$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster, myeloid.v2$Lv.2.Anno,
                                  "Myeloid: Lv.2.Anno by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
saveRDS(myeloid.v2, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "myeloid.nonintegrated.RDS"))
```

# TUMOUR ASSCOIATED MACROPHAGES - reclustered
## Normalisation by SCTransform v2 --> CSS integration
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
mac.only <-  subset(myeloid.v2, subset = Lv.2.Anno == "TAMs")

DefaultAssay(mac.only) <- "RNA"
Idents(mac.only) <- "Lv.2.Anno" #Lv.2.Anno = has no cDC2; Lv.2.Anno_revised has cDC2 and accurate number of lDCs

colnames(mac.only[[]]) #check which columns to remove
mac.only[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.1"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.2"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.3"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.4"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.5"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.6"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.7"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.0.9"]] <- NULL
mac.only[["SCT_snn_res.1"]] <- NULL

# DietSeurat
mac.only <- DietSeurat(mac.only)

#Normalisation
mac.only <- SplitObject(mac.only, split.by = "Sample")
mac.only <- lapply(mac.only, FUN= SCTransform, 
                              vst.flavor="v2",
                              assay = "RNA",
                              variable.features.n = 3000)

# Merge and set common features 
int.features.split <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = mac.only, nfeatures = 2000)
mac.simspec.sample.sct <- merge(x = mac.only[[1]], y = mac.only[2:length(mac.only)], 
                                  merge.data = TRUE)
VariableFeatures(mac.simspec.sample.sct) <- int.features.split

# PCA 
mac.simspec.sample.sct <- RunPCA(mac.simspec.sample.sct, verbose = TRUE, assay = "SCT", npcs = 30) #default npcs = 50

# Run CSS 
library(simspec)

# On running simspec_CSS on SCTranformed objects https://github.com/immunogenomics/simspec_CSS/issues/41
mac.simspec.sample.sct <-
  simspec::cluster_sim_spectrum(
    object = mac.simspec.sample.sct,
    label_tag = "orig.ident", #original sample labels from pre-processing step
    cluster_resolution = 0.4,
    corr_method = "pearson",
    spectrum_type = "corr_kernel"
  )

cat("Current reductions in object:", Reductions(mac.simspec.sample.sct)) # pca css
# Current reductions in object: pca css

# Reference codes from:  https://doi.org/10.17632/3kthhpw2pd 
mac.simspec.sample.sct <- RunUMAP(mac.simspec.sample.sct, reduction = "css", 
                                   dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(mac.simspec.sample.sct, "css")), #294
                                   reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_")

mac.simspec.sample.sct <- FindNeighbors(mac.simspec.sample.sct, reduction="css", 
                                         dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(mac.simspec.sample.sct, "css")))

mac.simspec.sample.sct <- FindClusters(mac.simspec.sample.sct, algorithm = 3,resolution = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1))

library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(mac.simspec.sample.sct)

mac.only <- mac.simspec.sample.sct
mac.only$seurat_clusters <- NULL
mac.only$seurat_clusters <- mac.only$SCT_snn_res.0.2 #stable clustering at res=0.1 and 0.2
Idents(mac.only) <- 'SCT_snn_res.0.2' 
DefaultAssay(mac.only) <- "SCT"
mac.only <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(mac.only)
mac.only.markers <- FindAllMarkers(mac.only, logfc.threshold = 0.20, min.pct = 0.1, only.pos = T)
topmarkers <- mac.only.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n=15) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
DotPlot(mac.only, features = topmarkers) + RotatedAxis() + scale_colour_gradient2(low = "darkblue", mid = "white", high = "darkred")
rm(mac.only)
```

## Annotation - mac subsets - simspec integration
`Lv.2.Anno` of the TAMs was assigned to the resolution-0.2 clusters by number in the original analysis. As above, it is read from the deposited object (`stage4_TAM_Lv.2.Anno`), and the original mapping is kept as `Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster` and compared with it. The Fig. 1C UMAP is drawn from the stored coordinates (`stage4_TAM_UMAP_1`, `_2`); the rerun UMAP is kept as `umap_css_rerun`.

```{r tam-annotation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
# Original mapping
metadata <- mac.simspec.sample.sct@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.2.Anno = case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.2 %in% c("0","2") ~ "TAMs_SPP1+",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.2 == "1" ~ "TAMs_C1QC+",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.2 == "3" ~ "TAMs_MHC_II",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.2 == "4" ~ "TAMs_OLR1+")) -> metadata
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(mac.simspec.sample.sct)))
mac.simspec.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster <- metadata$Lv.2.Anno

# Lv.2.Anno and the Fig. 1C UMAP from the deposited object
mac.simspec.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno <- deposited_labels(mac.simspec.sample.sct, "stage4_TAM_Lv.2.Anno")
mac.simspec.sample.sct@meta.data %>% group_by(Lv.1.Anno) %>% dplyr::count(Lv.2.Anno)
print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(mac.simspec.sample.sct$SCT_snn_res.0.2, mac.simspec.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno,
                                    "TAMs: rerun clusters (res 0.2) vs Lv.2.Anno", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(mac.simspec.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster, mac.simspec.sample.sct$Lv.2.Anno,
                                  "TAMs: Lv.2.Anno by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir), row.names = FALSE))
mac.simspec.sample.sct <- use_deposited_umap(mac.simspec.sample.sct, "stage4_TAM_UMAP")
saveRDS(mac.simspec.sample.sct, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "mac.only.simspec.RDS"))
```

## Pseudobulk analysis 
### by 4 TAMs subtypes
```{r}
## by macrophage subsets only
# Ref: #Ref: https://github.com/yunshun/HumanBreast10X/blob/main/RCode/NormTotal.R
mac <- mac.simspec.sample.sct
DefaultAssay(mac) <- "RNA"

# Converting cluster name into numerical
Idents(mac) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno <- as.factor(mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno)
print(levels(mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
#[1] "TAMs_C1QC+"  "TAMs_MHC_II" "TAMs_OLR1+"  "TAMs_SPP1+"
levels(mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) <- 1:length(levels(mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
print(1:length(levels(mac$Lv.2.Anno)))
#[1] 1 2 3 4
ClusterSub <- as.factor(mac@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) 

PatClust <- paste(mac$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#
counts <- mac@assays$RNA@counts #dgCMatrix
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
counts <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

ncls <- length(table(ClusterSub))
N <- 1:ncls #focus on all clusters
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% N] 
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, min.count=3, min.total.count=10) #min=10, min.total.count=20, min.count= 5 (3694 DEGs)
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

mac.col <- c("#FFAAA6","#00A9FF","#E68613", "#7CAE00")
plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 15, col = mac.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~ Cls + Pat)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(
    Cls1 = -(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4)/3,
    Cls2 = Cls2-(Cls3+Cls4)/3,
    Cls3 = Cls3-(Cls2+Cls4)/3,
    Cls4 = Cls4-(Cls2+Cls3)/3,
    levels=design)

de <- list()
for (i in 1:ncls) de[[i]] <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast = contr[,i])

#log-CPM
prior.count <- 1
ClstSub.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(ClstSub, log=T, prior.count=prior.count) #calculating cpm

# Remove batch effect on log-CPM
logCPM_no_batch <- removeBatchEffect(ClstSub.cpm, batch=Pat, group = Cls) # for visualisation purposes only
boxplot(as.data.frame(ClstSub.cpm),main="Original")
boxplot(as.data.frame(logCPM_no_batch),main="Batch corrected")
plotMDS(logCPM_no_batch, pch = 16, col = mac.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="Pseudo-bulk samples")

## Top significant genes
names(de) <- colnames(contr)   # label each result by its contrast

library(tibble)
res_list <- lapply(names(de), function(cn) {
  topTags(de[[cn]], n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(cluster = cn)
})
names(res_list) <- names(de)
res_all <- bind_rows(res_list)   # one long table with all contrasts
mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes <- res_all %>% mutate(cell_names = case_when(
                                         cluster == "Cls1" ~ "TAMs_C1QC+",
                                         cluster == "Cls2" ~ "TAMs_MHC_II", 
                                         cluster == "Cls3" ~  "TAMs_OLR1+",
                                         cluster == "Cls4" ~ "TAMs_SPP1+",
                                         )) 
# Supplementary Table 5 (originally saved as mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes_revised_FDR.csv)
write.csv(mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes, file.path(params$step_dir, "SupplementaryTable5_tam_pseudobulk.csv"), row.names = F)
```

```{r ext-data-fig-6a-heatmap-tam-subsets, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Cluster number -> subtype name
cell.map <- c("1" = "TAMs_C1QC+", "2" = "TAMs_MHC_II",
              "3" = "TAMs_OLR1+", "4" = "TAMs_SPP1+")

anno <- data.frame(
  Patient    = factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient),
  cell_names = factor(cell.map[as.character(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)],
                      levels = cell.map),
  row.names  = colnames(ClstSub)
)

# Colours: named vectors, as pheatmap requires
pat.levels <- levels(anno$Patient)
pat.col <- c("#6DE8B7","#D741E1","#B4E1CF","#DEB8E0","#DD4A8C","#7F9F32","#C3EAB4" ,"#7B67E0" ,"#D8E746" ,"#CEE982" ,"#DE73DA" ,"#92A36F" ,"#67C0D8" ,"#E1A497" ,"#E76356" ,"#62A4DB", "#D79655" ,"#8966AA", "#9899E8" ,"#6EE9E7","#E4C751" ,"#E7E3DA" ,"#E08FC1" ,"#8D747A") 
ann_colors <- list(
  cell_names = setNames(mac.col[N],
                        c( "TAMs_C1QC+", "TAMs_MHC_II","TAMs_OLR1+", "TAMs_SPP1+")),
  Patient    = setNames(pat.col[seq_along(pat.levels)], pat.levels)
)

top <- 25
top.markers <- mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes %>%
  filter(logFC > 0) %>%                      # up-regulated only
  group_by(cell_names) %>%
  arrange(FDR, PValue, .by_group = TRUE) %>% # PValue breaks ties in FDR
  slice_head(n = top) %>%
  ungroup()

Markers <- unique(top.markers$gene)          # same as !duplicated() in your old code
table(top.markers$cell_names)  

library(pheatmap)
mat <- t(scale(t(logCPM_no_batch[Markers, ])))
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat, color=colorRampPalette(c("steelblue","white","darkred"))(100), border_color="NA",
    breaks=seq(-2,2,length.out=101), cluster_cols=TRUE, scale="none", fontsize_row=8, 
    show_colnames=FALSE, treeheight_row=70, treeheight_col=70, cutree_cols=4, #cutree_rows = 4,
    clustering_method="ward.D2",
    annotation_col=anno, annotation_colors=ann_colors
    )
```

## ORA analysis
```{r ext-data-fig-6b-ORA, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library("msigdbr")
library("clusterProfiler")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
Hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
Hallmark.entrez <- dplyr::select(Hallmark, gs_name, entrez_gene)

gene.symbols <- mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes$gene %>% unique() 
gene.entrez <- bitr(gene.symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", drop = F)
colnames(gene.entrez)[1] <- "gene"
markers.ann <- left_join(mac.cellnames.pseudobulk.4subtypes, gene.entrez, by = "gene")

dgea.ls <- split(markers.ann, f=markers.ann$cell_names)

#focus on up-regulated genes
dgea.up.filtered <- purrr::map(dgea.ls, ~ dplyr::filter(., logFC > 1 & FDR < 0.05, !is.na(ENTREZID)))
dgea.ls.up.entrez.id <- purrr::map(dgea.up.filtered, ~ dplyr::pull(., ENTREZID)) #pulling a gene list

universe <- bitr(gene.symbols,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
```

## GO BP
```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=8, message=FALSE}
compare.clusters.GO.bp <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = dgea.ls.up.entrez.id,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  universe = universe$ENTREZID,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable      = TRUE)
dotplot(compare.clusters.GO.bp, showCategory =4, font.size = 11, title = "GO BP |pseudobulk RNA assay| logFC>1 & FDR<0.05") + scale_colour_gradient(low="darkgreen", high = "grey") + RotatedAxis()
```

## Hallmark
```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=8, message=FALSE}
hallmark <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = dgea.ls.up.entrez.id, 
  fun = "enricher",
  minGSSize = 8,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  universe = universe$ENTREZID,
  TERM2GENE = Hallmark.entrez) 
dotplot(hallmark, showCategory = 5, title="Hallmark |pseudobulk RNA assay| logFC>1 & FDR<0.05")  + RotatedAxis() + scale_colour_gradient(low="midnightblue", high = "grey") 
```

# UCELL Score against known TAM signature
```{r ext-data-fig-6c-Ucellscore, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
TAMsign <- list()
#https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2019.05.054 Jaitin et al., 
TAMsign$LAM <- c("CTSD","APOC1","LIPA","APOE","FABP5","PLA2G7","CHIT1","SPP1","FABP4","CD36","LPL")

#https://doi.org/10.1016/j.it.2022.04.008 7 TAM subsets identified in almost all cancer types
TAMsign$angiogenesis.Z <- c("VEGFA","VCAN","FCN1","THBS1","HIF1A","INHBA","AREG","PPARG","TIMP1","SERPINB2","OLR1")

#https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2021.01.010 Cheng et al.,
TAMsign$phagocytosis <- c("MRC1","CD163","MERTK","C1QB") 
TAMsign$Angiogenesis <- c("CCND2","CCNE1","CD44","CXCR4","E2F3","EDN1","EZH2","FGF18","FGFR1","FYN","HEY1","ITGAV","JAG1","JAG2", "NOTCH1","PDGFA","PTK2","STC1","TNFAIP6","TYMP","VAV2","VCAN","VEGFA","MMP9","SPP1")
TAMsign$M1 <- c("IL23","TNF","CXCL9","CXCL10","CXCL11","CD86","IL1A","IL1B","IL6","CCL5","IRF5","IRF1","CD40","IDO1","KYNU","CCR7")
TAMsign$M2 <- c("IL4R","CCL4","CCL13","CCL20","CCL17","CCL18","CCL22","CCL24","LYVE1","VEGFA","VEGFB","VEGFC","VEGFD","EGF","CTSA","CTSB","CTSC","CTSD","TGFB1","TGFB2","TGFB3","MMP14","MMP19","MMP9","CLEC7A","WNT7B","FASL","TNFSF12","TNFSF8","CD276","VTCN1","MSR1","FN1","IRF4")

## IL1B+ macrophages (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06685-2)
TAMsign$IL1B.sig <- c("IL1B","IER3","SOD2","IL1A","CXCL2","CXCL3","PTGS2","TNF","IL6","TRAF1","BCL2A1","GPR84","CXCL1","CLEC4E","GCH1") #"THBS1",
TAMsign$MKI67.sig <- c("MKI67","PCLAF","TOP2A","TK1","TPX2","UBE2C","BIRC5","CDK1","CENPF","RRM2","KNL1","NUSAP1","STMN1","MCM7","SMC2","ATAD2")
TAMsign$FOLR2.sig <- c("SELENOP","FOLR2","F13A1","SLCO2B1","PLTP","STAB1","LYVE1","MRC1","GPR34","TMEM176B","MS4A7","IGF1","AP2A2","TMEM176A","GAS6","MAF","SLC9A9","IGFBP4","NAAA")
TAMsign$SPP1.sig <- c("CTSD","GPNMB","LGALS3","CD63","VAT1","SPP1","FABP5","LPL","PLPP3","CD36","PLD3","ERO1A","ANPEP","ATP6V0D2","INHBA")

# UCell Scoring
library(UCell)
DefaultAssay(mac.simspec.sample.sct) <- "RNA"
Idents(mac.simspec.sample.sct) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
mac.simspec.sample.sct <- AddModuleScore_UCell(mac.simspec.sample.sct, features = TAMsign,
                                 assay="RNA", slot = "data")
TAMsign.names <- paste0(names(TAMsign),"_UCell")

# FeaturePlot(mac.simspec.sample.sct, 
#             features = TAMsign.names, 
#             max.cutoff = "q99", # q## indicates quantile 
#             ncol = 2,
#             cols = c("lightgrey", "darkred"),
#             keep.scale = "all") # to apply the same scale

# Average expression from DotPlot
d <- DotPlot(mac.simspec.sample.sct, features = TAMsign.names, scale = F)
ddata <- as.data.frame(d[["data"]])
df_spread <- tidyr::spread(ddata[,c(1,3,4)], id, avg.exp) # use non-scale to show 
df_spread <- na.omit(df_spread)
rownames(df_spread) <- df_spread[,1]
df_spread <- df_spread[,-1]
mat<- as.matrix(df_spread)
sum(is.infinite(mat)) # to test that there are no infinite values
sum(is.na(mat))
library(viridis)
library(pheatmap)
phet <- pheatmap(mat, 
                 #color = colorRampPalette(c("white","darkred"))(100), 
                 color = mako(n=15),
                 fontsize = 15,
                 cellheight = 15, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T,
                 border_color = F, 
                 fontsize_row = 12, cutree_cols = 1, cutree_rows = 3,
                 breaks=seq(0, 0.6,length.out=15),
                 cellwidth = 15, scale = "none")
```
